translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Emperor Yuan's Taixing reign (318 CE), the court first decreed that feudal stipends would be one-ninth of fief revenue.

sentences.zh: 太傅，太保，太宰，太尉，司徒，司空，大司馬，大將軍，諸位從公。

translations.literal: Grand Tutor, Grand Protector, Grand Preceptor, Grand Commandant, Minister over the Masses, Minister of Works, Grand Marshal, Grand General, and all Bearer of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor, Grand Protector, Grand Preceptor, Grand Commandant, Minister over the Masses, Minister of Works, Grand Marshal, Grand General, and all Bearers of the Staff with Equal Rank to the Three Dukes.

sentences.zh: 右第一品。

translations.literal: These are the First Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: First Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 特進，驃騎，車騎，衛將軍，諸大將軍，諸持節都督。

translations.literal: Special Advancement, Swift Cavalry, Chariots and Cavalry, Guard General, all Grand Generals, and all Area Commanders-in-Chief with Staff and Credentials.
translations.idiomatic: Special Advancement; Generals of Swift Cavalry, Chariots and Cavalry, and the Guard; all Grand Generals; and all Area Commanders-in-Chief with Staff and Credentials.

sentences.zh: 右第二品。

translations.literal: These are the Second Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Second Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 侍中，散騎常侍，尚書令，僕射，尚書，中書監，令，秘書監，諸征、鎮至龍驤將軍，光祿大夫，諸卿，尹，太子二傅，大長秋，太子詹事，領、護軍，縣侯。

translations.literal: Palace Attendant, Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary, Secretariat Director, Vice Director, Secretariat Attendants, Secretariat Supervisor and Director, Palace Secretariat Supervisor, all Area and Garrison Generals through General of the Dragon Prancing, Imperial Household Grandee, various ministers, metropolitan commandants, the crown prince's two tutors, Grand Director of the Long Autumn, Crown Prince Steward, Commander and Protector of the Army, and district marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Palace Attendant; Cavalier Attendant-in-Ordinary; Secretariat Director and Vice Director; Secretariat Attendants; Secretariat Supervisor and Director; Palace Secretariat Supervisor; Area and Garrison Generals through General of the Dragon Prancing; Imperial Household Grandee; the various ministers and metropolitan commandants; the crown prince's two tutors; Grand Director of the Long Autumn; Crown Prince Steward; Commander and Protector of the Army; and district marquises.

sentences.zh: 右第三品。

translations.literal: These are the Third Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Third Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 二衛至五校尉，甯朔至五威、五武將軍，四中郎將，刺史領兵者，戎蠻校尉，禦史中丞，都水使者，鄉侯。

translations.literal: The two guards through the five commandants, Pacifying the North through the Five Majestic and Five Martial Generals, the four generals of the gentlemen-of-the-household, regional inspectors commanding troops, Commandant Who Pacifies the Southern Man, Censor-in-Chief, Director of Waters, and township marquises.
translations.idiomatic: The two guard generals through the five commandants; Pacifying the North through the Five Majestic and Five Martial generals; the four Gentlemen-of-the-Household generals; regional inspectors with military command; Commandant Who Pacifies the Southern Man; Censor-in-Chief; Director of Waters; and township marquises.

sentences.zh: 右第四品。

translations.literal: These are the Fourth Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 給事中，黃門、散騎、中書侍郎，謁者僕射，三將，積射、強弩將軍，太子中庶子，庶子，三卿，率，鷹揚至陵江將軍，刺史不領兵者，郡國太守，內史，相，亭侯。

translations.literal: Attendant Within; Yellow Gate, Cavalier, and Secretariat Attendants; Usher Vice Director; the three generals; Generals of Accumulated Archery and Strong Crossbows; crown prince's Palace Attendants, Secondary Sons, three ministers, and Directors of the Watch; Soaring Hawk through Crossing-the-River Generals; regional inspectors without troops; commandery and state Grand Administrators, Grand Administrators of the Interior, and chancellors; and pavilion marquises.
translations.idiomatic: Attendant Within; Yellow Gate, Cavalier, and Secretariat Attendants; Usher Vice Director; the three army generals; Generals of Accumulated Archery and Strong Crossbows; the crown prince's Palace Attendants, Secondary Sons, three chief ministers, and Directors of the Watch; Soaring Hawk through Crossing-the-River generals; regional inspectors without troops; commandery and state Grand Administrators, Grand Administrators of the Interior, and chancellors; and pavilion marquises.

sentences.zh: 右第五品。

translations.literal: These are the Fifth Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Fifth Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 尚書丞，郎，治書侍御史，侍御史，三都尉，博士，撫軍以上及持節都督領護長史，司馬，公府從事中郎將，廷尉正，監，評，秘書著作丞，郎，王國公三卿，師，友，文學，諸縣署令千石者，太子門大夫，殿中將軍，司馬督，雜號護軍，闕內侯。

translations.literal: Secretariat Assistant Directors and Attendants; Imperial Secretary and Attendant Imperial Secretaries; the three commandants; Erudites; Pacifying-the-Army and higher and Area Commanders-in-Chief with Staff and Credentials with their Protector chief clerks and masters of horse; Staff Officer of the Princely Household; Minister of Justice Rectifier, Supervisor, and Assessor; Palace Secretariat Authoring Assistant Directors and Attendants; the three ministers of ducal states, Teacher, Friend, and Literary Scholar; all county magistrates at one thousand bushels; crown prince Gate Grand Master; Palace Hall General and Master-of-Horse Supervisor; miscellaneous Protectors of the Army; and Marquis within the Passes.
translations.idiomatic: Secretariat Assistant Directors and Attendants; Imperial Secretary and Attendant Imperial Secretaries; the three commandants; Erudites; Pacifying-the-Army generals and above, and Area Commanders-in-Chief with Staff and Credentials together with their Protector chief clerks and masters of horse; Staff Officer of the Princely Household; Minister of Justice Rectifier, Supervisor, and Assessor; Palace Secretariat Authoring Assistant Directors and Attendants; the three ministers of ducal states plus Teacher, Friend, and Literary Scholar; county magistrates at one thousand bushels; crown prince Gate Grand Master; Palace Hall General and Master-of-Horse Supervisor; miscellaneous Protectors of the Army; and Marquises within the Passes.

sentences.zh: 右第六品。

translations.literal: These are the Sixth Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Sixth Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 謁者，殿中監，諸卿尹丞，太子傅詹事率丞，諸軍長史、司馬六百石者，諸府參軍，戎蠻府長史，司馬，公府掾，屬，太子洗馬，舍人，食官令，諸縣令六百石者。

translations.literal: Ushers; Director Within the Hall; assistant directors of ministers and metropolitan commandants; assistant directors of the crown prince's tutors, steward, and directors of the watch; army chief clerks and masters of horse at six hundred bushels; staff officers of various offices; chief clerk and master of horse of the Southern Man headquarters; princely household clerks and aides; crown prince Groom-in-Waiting, Attendants, and Diet Director; and county magistrates at six hundred bushels.
translations.idiomatic: Ushers; Director Within the Hall; assistant directors of ministers and metropolitan commandants; assistant directors for the crown prince's tutors, steward, and Directors of the Watch; army chief clerks and masters of horse at six hundred bushels; staff officers of various offices; chief clerk and master of horse of the Southern Man headquarters; princely household clerks and aides; crown prince Groom-in-Waiting, Attendants, and Diet Director; and county magistrates at six hundred bushels.

sentences.zh: 右第七品。

translations.literal: These are the Seventh Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Seventh Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 內台正令史，郡丞，諸縣署長，雜號宣威將軍以下。

translations.literal: Chief clerks of the inner secretariat; commandery assistants; chiefs of county offices; and miscellaneous Proclaiming Authority Generals and below.
translations.idiomatic: Chief clerks of the inner secretariat; commandery assistants; chiefs of county offices; and miscellaneous Proclaiming Authority generals and below.

sentences.zh: 右第八品。

translations.literal: These are the Eighth Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Eighth Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 內台書令史，外台正令史，諸縣署丞，尉。

translations.literal: Document clerks of the inner secretariat; chief clerks of the outer secretariat; county assistants and commandants.
translations.idiomatic: Document clerks of the inner secretariat; chief clerks of the outer secretariat; and county assistants and commandants.

sentences.zh: 右第九品。

translations.literal: These are the Ninth Rank, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Ninth Rank (right column).

sentences.zh: 凡新置不見此諸條者，隨秩位所視，蓋囗囗右所定也。

translations.literal: For any newly established offices not found in these entries, they follow the rank to which they are attached—this was fixed in the Western Jin, right column.
translations.idiomatic: Any newly created office not listed here takes the rank to which it is attached; this table was fixed in the Western Jin, as shown in the right-hand column.
